title: Graph Coarsening Enables Escaping Local Optima in Compute-Constrained Nonconvex MAX-CUT
abstract: arXiv:2610.19043v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Because its binary optimization landscape contains exponentially many local optima, MAX-CUT is highly sensitive to initialization. We study Particle Polynomial Relaxation (PPR), a moment-based nonconvex continuous reformulation possessing an advantageous optimization landscape. We warm-start PPR with Combinatorial Multigrid (CMG), a spectral graph-coarsening method that produces structure-aware initial solutions in near-linear time without training data. On \texttt{t2g20} ($n=400$), benchmark instance with known exact optimum, the combined CMG+PPR pipeline reaches $97.5\%$ of optimum on average and $98.4\%$ on the best run. An extended variant with discrete local-search refinement reaches the published optimum on all sixty Biq Mac instances evaluated by a recent neural branch-and-bound method. Using a sparse CSR representation, the same approach scales to G-set instances with up to $20{,}000$ vertices reducing memory requirements by up

translated_title: 图粗化使计算受限的非凸MAX-CUT问题能够逃离局部最优
translated_abstract: 由于MAX-CUT的二值优化景观包含指数级数量的局部最优解，该问题对初始化高度敏感。我们研究了粒子多项式松弛（PPR），这是一种基于矩的非凸连续重构方法，具有优越的优化景观。我们使用组合多重网格（CMG）对PPR进行热启动，CMG是一种谱图粗化方法，能够在近线性时间内生成结构感知的初始解，且无需任何训练数据。在t2g20（n=400）这一已知精确最优解的基准实例上，CMG+PPR组合管线平均达到最优解的97.5%，最佳运行达到98.4%。带有离散局部搜索改进的扩展变体，在最近一种神经分支定界方法所评估的全部六十个Biq Mac实例上均达到了已发表的最优解。借助稀疏CSR表示，相同方法可扩展到多达20,000个顶点的G-set实例，最多可将内存需求降低……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出将近线性时间的谱图粗化方法CMG用于热启动具有优良优化景观的粒子多项式松弛（PPR），使计算受限的非凸MAX-CUT优化能够逃离局部最优，在基准实例上平均达到97.5%的最优解、并在全部Biq Mac测试实例上达到已发表最优解，还可扩展至两万顶点规模并大幅降低内存需求。
en_tdlr: By warm-starting Particle Polynomial Relaxation (PPR) with the near-linear-time spectral graph-coarsening method Combinatorial Multigrid (CMG), this paper enables escaping local optima in compute-constrained nonconvex MAX-CUT, achieving 97.5% of the optimum on average on benchmarks, matching the published optimum on all Biq Mac instances, and scaling to graphs with 20,000 vertices with greatly reduced memory requirements.
